title: Mobile Device Management
scenario: A healthcare organization has already synchronized its on-premises Active Directory environment with Microsoft Entra ID. The next phase is to transition domain-joined Windows endpoints into a hybrid management model by enabling Hybrid Azure AD Join, automatic Microsoft Intune enrollment, application deployment, device compliance evaluation, and update governance. Before the organization can rely on centralized cloud-based endpoint management, the device registration path, automatic enrollment controls, application deployment workflow, compliance configuration, and update-ring settings must all be validated.

reference.label: Enrollment type
reference.value: Hybrid Azure AD Join with automatic MDM enrollment

reference.label: Required GPO setting
reference.value: Enable automatic MDM enrollment using default Azure AD credentials

activities.title: Task 1 - Configure Hybrid Azure AD Join
activities.prompt: You want to prepare Azure AD Connect so that domain-joined Windows devices can automatically register with Microsoft Entra ID by using the Service Connection Point. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Open Azure AD Connect and select Configure
Select Configure device options
Authenticate with a Global Administrator or Hybrid Identity Administrator account
Select Configure Hybrid Azure AD Join
Select Windows 10 or later domain-joined devices
Select the domain, choose Microsoft Entra ID as the authentication service, and provide Enterprise Admin credentials
Review the summary and complete the configuration

activities.explanation: The lab begins with Azure AD Connect device configuration so the SCP can be published for hybrid registration discovery.

activities.title: Task 2 - Configure Automatic MDM Enrollment
activities.prompt: You want devices owned by synchronized users to enroll into Intune automatically after registration. To answer, select the MDM user scope setting that best supports that objective.
activities.explanation: The lab explicitly sets the Intune automatic enrollment scope to All.

activities.title: Task 3 - Map the GPO Configuration
activities.prompt: You want to configure the Group Policy object that enables automatic Microsoft Intune enrollment on the client device. To answer, match each configuration element on the left with the correct value or location on the right.
right: Computer Configuration → Administrative Templates → Windows Components → MDM
Enable automatic MDM enrollment using default Azure AD credentials

answer.Policy path: Computer Configuration → Administrative Templates → Windows Components → MDM
answer.Policy name: Enable automatic MDM enrollment using default Azure AD credentials

activities.explanation: The lab configures a computer-side MDM policy and explicitly sets the enrollment option to User Credential.

activities.title: Task 4 - Validate Hybrid Join and Enrollment Readiness
activities.prompt: You want to refresh policy, verify hybrid device registration, and confirm that the device has an MDM enrollment endpoint. To answer, select the appropriate value for each blank in the command sequence.
activities.explanation: The lab validates successful hybrid registration by checking AzureAdJoined, DomainJoined, and that the MDMUrl field is populated.

activities.title: Task 5 - Verify the Device in Entra ID
activities.prompt: You want to verify that the client device completed hybrid registration in Microsoft Entra ID. To answer, select the join type that should be displayed for NV-CLI in the Entra devices list.
activities.explanation: The validation step in Entra ID confirms that NV-CLI is listed as Microsoft Entra hybrid joined.

activities.title: Task 6 - Deploy Microsoft 365 Apps
activities.prompt: You want to deploy Microsoft 365 Apps for Windows to all managed users from Intune. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Open Intune Admin Center and go to Apps → Windows → Create
Choose Microsoft 365 Apps for Windows 10 and later
Review the App suite information page
Configure the app suite for 64-bit architecture, Open Document Format, and Current Channel
Assign the deployment to All users
Review the summary and create the deployment
Verify that Microsoft 365 applications appear on NV-CLI

Review the App suite information page
Configure the app suite for 64-bit architecture, Open Document Format, and Current Channel
Assign the deployment to All users
Review the summary and create the deployment
Verify that Microsoft 365 applications appear on NV-CLI
activities.explanation: The app deployment workflow in the lab moves from app creation to configuration, assignment, creation, and verification on the client.

activities.title: Task 7 - Map the Microsoft 365 App Suite Settings
activities.prompt: You want the Microsoft 365 app deployment to match the required configuration used in the lab. To answer, match each setting on the left with the correct configured value on the right.
activities.explanation: The app suite is configured with 64-bit architecture, ODF default format, Current Channel, and shared computer activation set to No.

activities.title: Task 8 - Configure Device Compliance
activities.prompt: You want to create a Windows device compliance policy that evaluates hybrid devices against core security requirements. To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Go to Devices → Compliance → Policies and create a new policy
Select Windows 10 and later with the Windows 10/11 compliance policy profile
Name the policy NewVue – Windows Device Compliance
Require encryption, firewall, TPM, and antivirus under System Security
Keep the default noncompliance action as Mark device noncompliant immediately
Assign the policy to All users
Review NV-CLI under Device compliance

activities.explanation: The compliance workflow in the lab is policy creation, security requirement configuration, assignment, and status validation.

activities.title: Task 9 - Interpret Compliance Evaluation
activities.prompt: You want to interpret the result after opening NV-CLI in Intune and viewing Device compliance. To answer, select the set of states that the lab identifies as possible evaluation outcomes.
activities.explanation: The lab notes that Intune can show Compliant, Not compliant, or Pending during compliance evaluation.

activities.title: Task 10 - Create the Update Ring Configuration
activities.prompt: You want to configure the update management baseline described in the lab. To answer, select the appropriate value for each blank in the configuration statement.
script: Update ring name: NewVue – Update Ring
activities.explanation: The update ring in the lab uses a 7-day feature deferral, 2-day quality deferral, and is assigned to All users.
